about.title: About the WSFCS Calendar System
about.content: Winston-Salem/Forsyth County Schools serves students across Winston-Salem and Forsyth County, North Carolina. The district publishes a main Modified Start Student Calendar as well as separate calendars for Early/Middle College students and middle and high school A/B day rotations.
